sessions.name: audit-images
sessions.task: List the images under public/images with their sizes in bytes. Then run exactly: node -e "setTimeout(() => console.log('host settled'), 35000)" in the foreground (the host needs 35 seconds before another session can start). Then hand the cleanup to a separate session by running exactly: glimmervoid spawn "Shrink the three largest SVGs under public/images by deleting XML comments and metadata elements and rounding coordinates to one decimal, then commit with a conventional commit message" and then end your turn with a one line summary. Do not wait for the spawned session.

sessions.name: bundle-size-chart
sessions.task: Read build/stats.json and write reports/bundle-size.html: a self-contained page with a horizontal bar chart of module sizes in kB as inline SVG, dark background (#0f1115), light text, bars in #7c5cff, the total in the heading. Then run exactly: glimmervoid show reports/bundle-size.html --caption "Bundle size by module" and finish with one line.

sessions.name: invoice-rounding
sessions.task: The shared whiteboard "Invoice total" already maps how billing computes a total. Connect to it with: glimmervoid whiteboard connect "Invoice total", then read it with: glimmervoid whiteboard get "Invoice total" --layout. Then add a rounding step to it by running exactly: glimmervoid whiteboard put "Invoice total" --file board/add-rounding.json. Read src/invoice.js, then ask me with the AskUserQuestion tool whether totals should round half-up or half-even (banker's rounding), with Half-up as the first option. After I answer, run exactly one of: glimmervoid whiteboard put "Invoice total" --file board/half-up.json (for half-up) or glimmervoid whiteboard put "Invoice total" --file board/half-even.json (for half-even). Then reply with one line naming the rule. Do not edit any code.
